order_note: features are listed in the order the model receives them (ENC.features). Categories are given as names; the engines' frame holds the position in this list as the code.
target: natural log of the price in rupees (predictions are exp(...) of the model output)

features.name: class
features.label: Cabin class
features.description: Cabin: Economy, Premium Economy or Business

features.name: days_left
features.label: Days before departure
features.description: Days between booking and departure (1 to 50 in the data)

features.name: period
features.label: Data period (which scrape)
features.description: Which scrape the price level comes from (2022 or 2023)

features.name: dep_hour
features.label: Departure hour
features.description: Exact departure hour (2023 scrape only; empty for 2022)
features.note: exact time is only known for the 2023 scrape; may be empty

features.name: arr_hour
features.label: Arrival hour
features.description: Exact arrival hour (2023 scrape only; empty for 2022)
features.note: exact time is only known for the 2023 scrape; may be empty

features.name: distance_km
features.label: Distance (km)
features.description: Great-circle distance between the two cities

features.name: te_flight
features.label: Usual price level of this flight
features.description: Typical log price of this flight code and class, computed out-of-fold
features.derived_note: computed from the training data: the usual (log) price of this flight code and class, so changing it moves the price level directly
features.unit: natural log of the price in rupees

features.name: te_route_airline
features.label: Usual price level of this airline on this route
features.description: Typical log price of this airline on this route and class, computed out-of-fold
features.derived_note: computed from the training data: the usual (log) price of this airline on this route and class
features.unit: natural log of the price in rupees

features.name: route_supply
features.label: Flights on this route (competition)
features.description: Number of distinct flights on the route and class (competition proxy)
features.derived_note: computed from the training data: number of distinct flights on this route and class (a competition proxy)
